oneLine: Hillhouse Capital-backed Elevate Campuses to open Rs 2,100-crore IPO.

sources.title: Hillhouse Capital-backed Elevate Campuses to open Rs 2,100-crore IPO on September 23

synopsis: Hillhouse Capital-backed Elevate Campuses has filed its red herring prospectus to open an initial public offering to raise Rs 2,100 crore through an entirely fresh issue of shares, with no offer-for-sale component. The public subscription will run from September 23 to September 25, following an anchor book opening on September 22, with share listing expected on September 30. The company intends to use Rs 1,100 crore of the net proceeds to acquire K-12 entities and campuses from fellow promoter subsidiaries, Rs 750 crore to repay debt, and the remainder for inorganic growth and general corporate purposes. Elevate Campuses is promoted by Genius Bidco Holdings and Genius Rajkot Investment Holdings, controlled by Hillhouse Investment. JM Financial, IIFL Capital Services, and Morgan Stanley India Company are serving as merchant bankers for the public issue.
